mapper.sql: select o.order_id, o.order_no, o.order_title, o.customer_id, o.customer_name, shop_dept.dept_name as target_dept_name, coalesce(detail_summary.total_quantity, 0) as total_quantity, coalesce(detail_summary.delivered_quantity, 0) as delivered_quantity, coalesce(detail_summary.remaining_quantity, 0) as remaining_quantity, o.total_amount, o.order_date, o.status, o.shop_dept_id, o.applicant_id, o.applicant_name, u.nick_name as applicant_nick_name, o.applicant_dept_id, applicant_dept.dept_name as applicant_dept_name, o.create_by, o.create_time, o.update_by, o.update_time, o.remark from inv_sales_order o left join sys_dept shop_dept on shop_dept.dept_id = o.shop_dept_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = o.applicant_id left join sys_dept applicant_dept on applicant_dept.dept_id = o.applicant_dept_id left join ( select order_id, sum(coalesce(quantity, 0)) as total_quantity, sum(coalesce(delivered_quantity, 0)) as delivered_quantity, sum(coalesce(quantity, 0) - coalesce(delivered_quantity, 0)) as remaining_quantity from inv_sales_detail group by order_id ) detail_summary on detail_summary.order_id = o.order_id
mapper.select: select order_id, order_no, order_title, customer_id, customer_name, total_amount, order_date, status, shop_dept_id, applicant_id, applicant_name, applicant_dept_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from inv_sales_order where order_id = #{orderId} for update
mapper.delete:
delete from inv_sales_order where order_id in
#{orderId}
